facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note: Cedric owes the party 975 gold, three-quarters price for their treasure, once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked to town. The note is committed to paying Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.
The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note for joining the party. The exact split or terms were not stated.
facts.uncertain_reason: The terms of the recruitment, including how much of the note each is promised, were not stated.

facts.text: Cedric says he cannot pay the note until his supply caravans flow again; his shipments have not come in since the dragon troubles began. This blocks paying Malzazarik and Lady Hilda from the note.
